name: Unpaid Balances by Month
description: Returns Unpaid Balances by Month report data.

parameters.name: property_visibility
parameters.description: The property visibility to filter by.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: The property filter. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter. If required, you must submit an id for at least one of the below filters.

parameters.name: parties_ids
parameters.description: The occupancy ids to filter by. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter. If required, you must submit an id for at least one of the below filters.

parameters.name: tenant_statuses
parameters.description: List of Tenant status to filter by.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: The comma-separated tag(s) to filter by

parameters.name: gl_account_ids
parameters.default: Your Rent Income Key Account IDs
parameters.description: The gl account ids to filter by.

parameters.name: occurred_on_from
parameters.description: The 'Period From' month to filter by.

parameters.name: occurred_on_to
parameters.description: The 'Period To' month to filter by.

parameters.name: accounting_basis
parameters.description: The accounting basis to filter by.

parameters.name: balance_operator
parameters.description: The Total Balance to filter by. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Returns the specified columns. All columns are returned by default. Look at the response schema to see the available columns.
